title: AiAnalysisRequest
description: Request payload posted by the UI/API to the internal AI service. Phase 7 only. The maskedQuery field MUST already be masked before this payload is constructed.

useCase.description: Which of the bounded use cases is being invoked.

maskedQuery.description: User query AFTER passing through the data masker. The AI service rejects requests that include unmasked tokens (validated by a server-side scan).

actor.description: User identity invoking the request. Used for AI audit.

relatedAlertId.description: Optional related alert. Retrieval may use this as a context anchor.

topK.description: Number of context chunks to retrieve before generation.
